messages.subject: Dynamic Input Problems
parts:
Hi, I've got an interesting issue with dynamic inputs.

I have a reactive function that updates a global data object.  I also have a dynamic input (using uiOuput/renderUI) as well as a plot that both call that reactive function and rely on the global object that gets updated.  The plot works fine and the dynamic input works fine, however when the plot has to rely on the dynamic input, it doesn't work.  I think it's a problem because the plot is getting generated before the dynamic UI is finished generating, and the plot doesn't get any data since the plot relies on the dynamic UI.

Anyways, here's an example of the server.r code:

Here's the data update part.  Everything works if I use the yellow line.  However, it breaks if I use the green line (which relies on the input$inputContentSelectItems)

getData<-reactive({
        dataUpdate()
        rsid<-input$RSID

        if(input$selectedPanel=="Content Metrics"){
            selectedDateGran<-input$inputContentGranularity
            selectedMetric<-input$inputContentMetric
            #selectedColumn<-7
            selectedColumn<-which(names(allData[[rsid]][["contentMetrics"]][["prop1"]][[selectedMetric]][[selectedDateGran]]) == as.character(input$inputContentSelectItems))
           
            dataMat<-allData[[rsid]][["contentMetrics"]][["prop1"]][[selectedMetric]][[selectedDateGran]]
            if(length(dataMat$Day)==0){dataMat$Day<-1}    
            dataMat$DateFormat<-as.Date(paste(dataMat$Month,"/",dataMat$Day,"/",dataMat$Year,sep=""  ),format="%m/%d/%Y")
            datesVec<-as.Date(as.character(dataMat$DateFormat))
            dataVec<-as.numeric(as.character(dataMat[,selectedColumn]))   
        } 
 
       list(datesVec,dataVec,selectedMetric,selectedDateGran)
})


Here's the plot output.  You can see that the plotting function relies on the reactive function output as well as some inputs.

output$anomolyContentPlot = renderPlot({
        dataUpdate()
        temp<-getData()

        datesVec<-temp[[1]]
        dataVec<-temp[[2]]
       
        dataVec
        metricName1<-temp[[3]]
        graphDateGranularity<-temp[[4]]

        meanSelection1<-as.numeric(input$modelOption1)
        meanSelection2<-as.numeric(input$modelOption2)
        stdevs<-as.numeric(input$stdevs)
        graphStartDate<-as.Date(input$inputDates[[1]])
        graphEndDate<-as.Date(input$inputDates[[2]])

        s.p<-as.numeric(input$srma)
        l.p<-as.numeric(input$lrma)
        e.p<-as.numeric(input$erma)

        plotAnomolies(meanSelection1,
            meanSelection2,
            stdevs,
            datesVec,
            dataVec,
            graphStartDate,
            graphEndDate,
            s.p,
            l.p,
            e.p,
            myMetricName=metricName1,
            graphDateGranularity=graphDateGranularity)
    })
